# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c24 P0](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c24 P0](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nonie  <sub>[v1 c24 P7](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora has fair, light hair, a pale and ethereal appearance, and dark-lashed, blue eyes. She is exceptionally tall, standing two inches taller than her peers, which sometimes makes her feel oversized and clumsy in large crowds.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c33 P0](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0000)_

## Personality

Honora possesses a thoughtful, reflective, and poetic nature, accompanied by a quick, self-deprecating sense of humor. Although she harbors deep, romantic imaginations and appreciates life's quiet beauty, she also displays a practical, sensible side when evaluating situations and people. She is deeply loyal to her friends and forms meaningful bonds with those who share her creative temperament.

_Sources: [v1 c20 P13](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0013), [v1 c21 P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c29 P21](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0021)_

- To excel in her studies at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v1 c29 P14](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- To create a comfortable, independent home with her college friends  <sub>[v1 c29 P13](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0013)</sub>

## History

Honora attended Regent's Academy, where she became a close friend of Nell Harcourt, Cressida Lindsay, Mabel Colby, and Odette Pullen. After graduating from her initial studies, she enrolled at Wexcombe College alongside Nell to pursue higher education, earning honors in Classics during her Freshman year. During her time at college, she rented and co-managed 'Tabby's Place,' a quaint house on Linden Avenue, alongside Nell, Mabel, Cressida, and her aunt, Jamesina. Honora's aunt, the author Charlotte E. Varley, visited her on Prince Edward Island and in Toronto, providing her with literary inspiration and connections.

_Sources: [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c29 P13](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0013), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c36 P0](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0000)_
